input.quote: When minimum night temperature is below 60°F use FOLEX 6 EC alone.
Do not apply Dropp® SC by ground or air when wind speeds exceed ten (10) miles per hour at the time of application.
AVOID APPLICATIONS DURING GUSTY WIND CONDITIONS.
Do not apply when wind causes drift to off-site vegetation as injury may occur.
If the windspeed is 10 miles per hour or less, applicators must use ½ swath displacement upwind at the downwind edge of the field.
